Task Name: Test runs must never reach the production database
Description: Database integration tests run only against a deliberately configured, isolated TEST database; a normal run is database-free; CI never targets production.
Requirement Reference: Safety correction found 29 Oct (default vitest loaded the production DATABASE_URL from .env); SRS 25.x environments
Workstream: Integration tests, security tests, documentation and handover

Completion Evidence: 29 Oct local run: plain `npx vitest run` with the real .env present skips all six database suites (57 tests) and passes 1277 with 0 failed. Config-level checks with fabricated URLs: a shell DATABASE_URL is blanked in workers; an opt-in naming the production endpoint or Supabase project is refused before any test starts; a valid fabricated isolated URL is accepted. A worker-level assertion fails the run if a database URL arrives without the opt-in. CI vitest jobs now pass TEST_* secrets only; the production secret is passed only as PRODUCTION_DATABASE_URL for the guard to refuse, and to the secret scanner.
Notes: The CI workflow change has not run on GitHub. Until a TEST_DATABASE_URL secret exists CI is database-free. Playwright e2e targets E2E_BASE_URL and is not covered by this gate; provider keys (Stripe, OpenAI, Resend) in .env are not blanked for tests and live-call behaviour of tests has not been audited. Leftover probe rows from earlier runs are unchecked: authorized operator runs the read-only SQL in docs/TESTING_SAFETY.md.
